tagline: Coding agents in your pocket — a local-first hub that watches, warns and lets you steer.

features.title: Live overview
features.text: One card per agent session: project, activity, status. Needs-you-first ordering.

features.title: Steering
features.text: Prompts reach the running agent — answer, stop, resume; never a second process.

features.title: Approvals
features.text: Agent questions reach your phone; decisions are attributed and crash-safe.

features.title: Agent teams
features.text: Plan work as a DAG, watch one card per worker, gate the risky steps.

features.title: Discovery
features.text: CLI sessions found on disk — preview, take over or copy, marked if running elsewhere.

features.title: PC workspace
features.text: Up to four sessions as tiles, keyboard-first, layout per machine.

features.title: Code & files
features.text: Search, open with line anchors, language diagnostics — inside the hub.

features.title: Multi-host fleet
features.text: All your machines in one surface; steering crosses hosts safely.

features.title: Local-first
features.text: Runs on your hardware, event-sourced, reachable via your tailnet — no cloud account.
